name: Cut Capsule Gaming
format: Gaming clip page: the best 20-59 s moments from official game trailers, tournaments and streamer VODs (Call of Duty, SEGA, GTA VI, Blizzard, Roblox), cut on the hook and the payoff, word-by-word captions

rules: never a GTA 6 story spoiler: no ending, no cutscene compilations, no big plot reveals (Rockstar removes them)
no hate, no harassment, no sexual content, no real-life violence
the clip must make sense to someone who never saw the video
